title: Unit 7: Indigenous Knowledge Systems
content:
ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! ✋✨
እንኳን ወደ Social Anthropology Unit 7 (Part 1) በሰላም መጣችሁ! በባለፈው ክፍላችን የUnit 6 ትምህርታችንን በስኬት አጠናቀናል። ዛሬ ደግሞ የሞጁሉን የመጨረሻ ክፍል የሆነውን Unit 7: Indigenous Knowledge Systems (IKS) እንጀምራለን። በዚህ ክፍል 7.1 Definition of Concepts, 7.2 Features of Indigenous Knowledge, እና 7.3 Significance of Indigenous Knowledge የሚሉትን ዋና ዋና ርዕሶች ለፈተና በሚመች መልኩ በጥልቀት እናያለን! 💡


7.1 DEFINITION OF CONCEPTS (IKS)

Indigenous Knowledge Systems (IKS) is called after different but closely related names, including: 'folk knowledge', 'local knowledge', 'non-formal knowledge', 'cultural knowledge', 'indigenous technical knowledge', 'traditional ecological knowledge', and 'traditional knowledge'. All these terms are essentially similar but differ in scope and domains. For instance, 'cultural knowledge' is broader in scope, while 'traditional ecological knowledge' is specific to ecology. Terms like 'indigenous', 'folk', and 'local' suggest 'originality' or uniqueness to a particular culture or geographic area.

Key Definitions by Scholars & Institutions:
• Mangetane (2001): Technical insight of wisdom gained and developed by people in a particular locality through years of careful observation and experimentation.
• Warren (1991): Body of empirical knowledge and beliefs handed down through generations of long-time inhabitants of a specific locale by cultural transmission.
• World Bank (1998): Large body of knowledge and skills developed outside the formal system.
• Hoppers (2005): Totality of knowledge and practices, whether explicit or implicit, used in managing socio-economic, ecological, and spiritual facets of life.
• IIRR (1996): Knowledge that people in a given community have developed over time, tested over centuries of use, and dynamic in nature.

👉 የሀገር በቀል እውቀት (IKS) ብያኔዎች፡
• የተለያዩ መጠሪያዎች: Folk knowledge, local knowledge, non-formal knowledge, cultural knowledge, traditional ecological knowledge:: እነዚህ ሁሉ በአንድ አካባቢ እና ባህል ውስጥ የበቀሉ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ (Originality) እውቀቶችን ያመለክታሉ::
• የምሁራን ብያኔ፡
- Mangetane:በትዝብት (Observation) እና በሙከራ (Experimentation) የተገኘ እውቀት::
- Warren:ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ በባህል የሚተላለፍ እውቀት::
- World Bank:ከመደበኛው የትምህርት ስርዓት (Formal system) ውጭ ያለ እውቀት::

Socio-Cultural Values Embedded in IKS:
• Socio-economic Values: Gender equality, hospitality, reciprocity, interdependence, productivity, and hard work.
• Moral Values: Collective codes of conduct regarding truthfulness and mutual help.
• Environmental Values: Respect and concern for natural environments, sacred lands, and sacred trees.
• Political Values: Egalitarianism, respect for laws, fairness, equality, rights, and duty.

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ የ Mangetane (Observation & Experimentation)፣ የ World Bank (Outside formal system) ብያኔዎች እና IKS ከያዟቸው እሴቶች (Socio-economic, Moral, Environmental, Political) መካከል 'ከዚህ ውስጥ የትኛው አይካተትም?' የሚል ጥያቄ በብዛት ይመጣሉ!


7.2 FEATURES OF INDIGENOUS KNOWLEDGE

According to Ellen and Harris (1996), indigenous knowledge has specific features that distinguish it from formal or international scientific knowledge:

a. Local (Not Universal): Rooted in a particular community and geographic area. Transferring it to another place risks dislocating it.
b. Tacit Knowledge: Not explicit or codified. Transferred through practices, myths, rituals, and symbols rather than academic jargon.
c. Transmitted Orally: Transmitted verbally or through imitation and demonstration. Codifying it may lead to the loss of some properties.
d. Experiential or Empirical: Based on trial and error, tested in the rigorous 'laboratory' of survival.
e. Learned through Repetition: Repetition aids in the retention and reinforcement of IK.
f. Constantly Changing: Dynamic in nature, continuously produced, reproduced, discovered, or lost.

👉 የሀገር በቀል እውቀት ባህሪያት (Ellen & Harris, 1996):
• Local: ሁለንተናዊ (Universal) አይደለም፤ የተወሰነ አካባቢና ባህል ላይ ብቻ የተመሰረተ ነው::
• Tacit: በጽሁፍ ያልተቀመጠ (Not codified) ሲሆን በልምድ፣ በተረትና በምልክቶች ይተላለፋል::
• Oral Transmission: በአፍ ወይም በተግባር በማየት/በመኮረጅ (Imitation) ይተላለፋል::
• Experiential: በፅንሰ-ሀሳብ ሳይሆን በዕለት ተዕለት የህይወት ልምድ እና ፈተና (Trial and error) የተረጋገጠ ነው::
• Constantly Changing: የማይለወጥ (Static) አይደለም፤ ሁልጊዜ የሚቀያየርና የሚዳብር (Dynamic) ነው::

💡 Exam Hint: Ellen and Harris ያስቀመጧቸው 6 ባህሪያት (Local, Tacit, Oral, Experiential, Repetition, Constantly changing) ለፈተና በጣም ወሳኝ ናቸው! በተለይም Tacit knowledge እና Not universal የሚሉት ነጥቦች በብዛት የሚጠየቁ ናቸው!

😂 ቅምሻ ቀልድ: የሀገር በቀል እውቀት በአፍ እና በምልክት ነው የሚተላለፈው (Tacit Knowledge)! ልክ እናቶቻችን ህፃን እያለን በእይታ ብቻ 'እንግዳው ፊት እንዳትበላ' ብለው እንደሚያስተላልፉልን መልዕክት ማለት ነው... የፅሁፍ መመሪያ አያስፈልገውም! 😂


7.3 SIGNIFICANCE OF INDIGENOUS KNOWLEDGE

Socio-cultural Anthropologists study IKS for two main purposes:
1. Understanding IK as an end by itself: To document how local communities produce, store, and transmit knowledge. Knowledge is power and an important tool of survival.
2. For Application (Development Interventions): IK forms the basis for local decision-making in agriculture, healthcare, and natural resource management. It offers cost-effective, sustainable, and culturally appropriate alternatives to expensive imported Western technologies.

IK and Scientific Knowledge (IK-SK Intersection):
• Alternative Option: IKS can be used as an alternative when it ensures cost-effective and appropriate methods for local problems.
• Combination/Complementary: Combining IK with scientific knowledge enhances project sustainability and efficiency.
• World Development Report (1998/99): A study of 121 rural water projects in 49 countries revealed a 70% success rate when local knowledge was incorporated, compared to only 10% success when it was excluded!

👉 የሀገር በቀል እውቀት ጠቀሜታ፡
• የጥናት አላማዎች: አንትሮፖሎጂስቶች IKSን የሚያጠናቸው እውቀቱን ለመረዳትና ለመሰነድ (To understand) እንዲሁም ለልማት ስራዎች ለመጠቀም (For application) ነው::
• ከዘመናዊ ሳይንስ ጋር ያለው ግንኙነት: የሀገር በቀል እውቀት እና የዘመናዊ ሳይንስ (Scientific Knowledge) ጥምረት ፕሮጀክቶች ተቀባይነትና ዘላቂነት እንዲኖራቸው ያደርጋል::
• የአለም ባንክ ጥናት (1998/99): የሀገር በቀል እውቀትን የተጠቀሙ የገጠር የውሃ ፕሮጀክቶች 70% ሲሳኩ፣ ያላካተቱት ግን 10% ብቻ ናቸው የተሳኩት!

💡 Exam Hint: የአለም ባንክ የውሃ ፕሮጀክቶች ስታቲስቲክስ (70% success with IK vs 10% without IK) እና የIK እና Scientific Knowledge ጥምረት ውጤታማነት በፈተና ላይ በብዛት ይመጣሉ!
